lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Ah, a <color=red>kindred</color> spirit! I'm Gus. I tend the gardens, and, on occasion, the English language.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: I was drafting an account of my prize pumpkin when a gust of wind carried five <color=red>words</color> clean off the page.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Choose the word that best completes each sentence. Restore all five, and five new books will appear in the library.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 1:
The seed was so <color=red>_____</color> that I nearly lost it between my fingers.
lines.hint: Not quite. What kind of seed could be lost between your fingers?
lines.correctText: The seed was so <color=red>minuscule</color> that I nearly lost it between my fingers.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 2:
It rained for a week; <color=red>_____</color>, the soil was perfectly soft by Friday.
lines.hint: Not quite. The second part is a result of the first. Which word links cause and effect?
lines.correctText: It rained for a week; <color=red>consequently</color>, the soil was perfectly soft by Friday.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 3:
I tended the shoot <color=red>_____</color>, watering it each dawn and shielding it from frost.
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about what watering it every dawn says about his effort.
lines.correctText: I tended the shoot <color=red>diligently</color>, watering it each dawn and shielding it from frost.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 4:
By midsummer the pumpkin was <color=red>_____</color>, easily the largest the village had ever seen.
lines.hint: Not quite. The clue is in the second half of the sentence.
lines.correctText: By midsummer the pumpkin was <color=red>colossal</color>, easily the largest the village had ever seen.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 5:
<color=red>_____</color> my modest expectations, it won first prize at the harvest fair.
lines.hint: Not quite. His expectations were modest, yet it won. Which word shows that contrast?
lines.correctText: <color=red>Despite</color> my modest expectations, it won first prize at the harvest fair.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Impeccable. My account is whole again, and five new <color=red>volumes</color> are making their way to the library.

afterLines.speaker: Gus
afterLines.text: Thank you once more. Do look in on the library, I suspect it's finally beginning to look the part.
